summary: Safe Bulkers, Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing that Euronext Athens confirmed all listing requirements for a dual listing of its common stock on the Main Market, subject to HCMC prospectus approval. The filing is a routine update on a cross-listing process, not a special situation. No price, premium, or deal terms are stated; the company remains listed on NYSE. Piraeus Bank is listing advisor; Potamitis Vekris and White & Case serve as legal counsel. Watch for commencement of trading date post-prospectus approval; no risk-arb angle as this is a dual listing, not a transaction.
